title: Multi-tenant data isolation

requirements.text: Every request resolves a tenant from trusted state, never from an unchecked client value
All reads and writes are filtered by tenant, so ids from another tenant behave as not found
The database enforces isolation (row-level security or equivalent), not only application code
Tests prove a user of tenant A cannot read or change tenant B's data

notes: Several feature packages (comments, rbac, chat, short-links) scope their own tables by tenant and test it, but no package provides tenant isolation for an application's data in general.
